editorial.blurb: Crying Tiger delivers bold, beautifully plated Southeast Asian cuisine in a stunning dining room where even a weeknight walk-in can feel like an occasion.
editorial.insiderTip: Skip the reservation stress—try walking in and grabbing bar seats at off-peak times; you'll likely score a spot quickly and can enjoy the vibe without the pressure of high-demand reservations.
signatureDishes: Crying Tiger dessert (wild Thai banana with Foster sauce and chocolate)
Wagyu short rib curry with crispy noodles
